def compute(df, **params):
    period = int(params.get("period", 14))

    close = df["close"].astype(float)
    delta = close.diff()

    gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
    loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)

    avg_gain = gain.ewm(
        alpha=1 / period,
        min_periods=period,
        adjust=False
    ).mean()

    avg_loss = loss.ewm(
        alpha=1 / period,
        min_periods=period,
        adjust=False
    ).mean()

    rs = avg_gain / avg_loss

    rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))

    rsi = rsi.mask(
        (avg_loss == 0) & (avg_gain > 0), 100
    )
    rsi = rsi.mask(
        (avg_loss == 0) & (avg_gain == 0), 50
    )

    return rsi.fillna(0).tolist()
